findings.reason: void-unsafe requires billing:void@billing-service, which billing-agent validly holds and admin is authorized to request, and billing:void@billing-service requires approval; compliance-officer independently hold standing, but none of their declared approval lifecycles can be proven to remain in state 'approved' — compliance-officer's can reach state 'revoked' via approved -[revoke]-> revoked, so it cannot be statically relied upon at time of exercise
